related.title: TCP Reno：慢啟動與門檻切換
related.titleEn: TCP Reno: slow start and threshold transition
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受missing+received=5000 B且所有範圍在傳送窗內；不由SACK推定應用已讀取。 交接時須能核對：交付 sack-blocks.csv、洞圖與重疊／重複區間測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require missing+received=5000 B and all ranges within the send window; SACK does not imply application consumption. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver sack-blocks.csv, hole diagrams and overlap/duplicate tests.
related.difference: 逐輪記錄cwnd、ssthresh、模式與ACK條件，不把MSS數與位元組混用。
related.differenceEn: Record cwnd, ssthresh, mode and ACK assumptions per round without mixing MSS counts and bytes.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
SACK描述已收到的位元組區間；區間可能重疊，不能直接相加造成重複計數。
教學基準：5000-(1000+1000+1000) = 2000 B missing；對照：5000-(1000+1000+1000+1000) = 1000 B missing。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

慢啟動和壅塞避免有不同增長機制；本課使用每RTT理想化模型，並非完整實作。
教學基準：10*2**3 = 80 MSS；對照：40+1 = 41 MSS。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
SACK describes received byte ranges; ranges may overlap and must not be naively summed.
Teaching baseline: 5000-(1000+1000+1000) = 2000 B missing; comparison: 5000-(1000+1000+1000+1000) = 1000 B missing. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Slow start and congestion avoidance grow differently; this course uses an idealized per-RTT model rather than a complete implementation.
Teaching baseline: 10*2**3 = 80 MSS; comparison: 40+1 = 41 MSS. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HTTP/3：串流內缺口與跨串流交付
related.titleEn: HTTP/3: within-stream gaps and cross-stream delivery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受missing+received=5000 B且所有範圍在傳送窗內；不由SACK推定應用已讀取。 交接時須能核對：交付 sack-blocks.csv、洞圖與重疊／重複區間測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require missing+received=5000 B and all ranges within the send window; SACK does not imply application consumption. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver sack-blocks.csv, hole diagrams and overlap/duplicate tests.
related.difference: 為每串流分別保存已收區間與可交付前綴，不共用單一連線offset。
related.differenceEn: Track received intervals and deliverable prefixes per stream rather than one connection offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

HTTP/3利用QUIC獨立串流減少傳輸層跨串流阻塞；同一串流仍需有序資料且QPACK可另造成相依。
教學基準：1000+4000 = 5000 deliverable B；對照：5000+4000 = 9000 deliverable B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

HTTP/3 uses independent QUIC streams to reduce transport cross-stream blocking; each stream remains ordered and QPACK can create separate dependencies.
